P <- matrix(c(0.05,0.10,0.05,0.05,0.30,0.10,0.10,0.10,0.15), nrow=3, byrow=TRUE)
xv <- 1:3; yv <- 1:3
EX <- sum(xv*rowSums(P)); EY <- sum(yv*colSums(P))
EXY <- sum(outer(xv, yv)*P)
answer <- EXY - EX*EY
